## What & why

Brief description of the change and the motivation.

## Type
- [ ] New module / feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Checklist
- [ ] `python eval/run_eval.py --selftest` passes
- [ ] `python -m compileall backend/app shell/backend/app eval` is clean
- [ ] Updated the relevant `docs/kb/` file if a module / endpoint / service / env var changed
- [ ] No secrets or personal data added (see `PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md`)
- [ ] Verified against a running stack (or noted why not)

## Notes for the reviewer
Anything worth calling out — trade-offs, follow-ups, screenshots.
